title: Golf hole package (hole.json), format version 2
description: The contract every hole producer (course_prep, course_gen) writes and every consumer (Unity, course trainer, game server) reads. See README.md in this folder for the rules that a schema can't express.

id.description: Stable package id; equals the package folder name.

course.description: Course name for display, e.g. 'Torrey Pines South' or 'Generated (forest)'.

holeRef.description: Hole number or label on its course.

theme.description: Look to dress the hole with (Unity CourseTheme name): coastal, parkland, forest, lakes, links, desert, mountain.

source.description: Where the layout came from. Informational only.

crs.description: osm: CRS of the original data, e.g. EPSG:32611.

originEasting.description: osm: easting of the tile's south-west corner in crs.

originNorthing.description: osm: northing of the tile's south-west corner in crs.

sizeMeters.description: Edge length of the square, north-up tile.

maxElevation.description: Meters; elevation of raw value 65535. Must be > minElevation.

holePath.description: Playing line from tee to pin (centre of the route).

sourceId.description: OSM id or generator label, for debugging.

rings.description: First ring = outer boundary, the rest = holes. Rings are closed implicitly.

water.description: Water surfaces: a flat level plus a triangulated outline. The terrain under them is already carved below the level.

level.description: Water surface elevation, meters (same datum as the heightmap).

triangles.description: Flat triangle list: 3 points (6 numbers) per triangle.

objects.description: Pointer to objects.bin, which holds EVERY tree, shrub and rock on the hole (binary layout in README.md). Consumers place exactly these, never more, fewer or elsewhere.

count.description: Number of records; must equal the count in the file header.

point.description: Meters from the tile's south-west corner: x = east, y = north.

points.description: Flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...] in meters (x = east, y = north).
